Genes : Skin colours : planches 1401, 1402, 1403, 1404, 1405, 1406, 1407

118 genes. The photograph frames the whole body in underwear, hair removed. Vanilla melanin genes (Skin_Melanin1..9) are the natural human skin tones; Genes Expanded - Skin (Workshop 3214172563) adds 75 colours.

Step texts: "<pawn>" has the gene "<defName>" (the gene replaces the previous skin colour gene), or any colour: "<pawn>" skin colour is rgb (<r>, <g>, <b>) (a skin colour of the colonist's own, which a gene gives way to: set it only when no skin gene is meant to show).

Roo's two mods added 2026-10-25 (run d15c, 72 values, 71 new): Roo's birthmarks and blemishes are tattoo defs too (RB*). Body_Royal exists in Ideology and in Roo's Starter Pack: the game keeps one def, Roo's when both are loaded, so its photograph depends on the mod list. Tattoo mods added 2026-10-31 (run 1a9d, map wsl-deps.look-catalogue-tattoo.map, 150 values listed): Misc Tattoos redefines Face_Stars, Face_Warpaint and Body_Dragon, which stay under Ideology and Tattoos Expanded here (one def wins in game). Not listed in that run: Avatar (grailnight.avatartat.v1, dropped by the run).

Female Body Variants (3798082132, tiagocc0.FemaleBodyVariants, in the map): it ships no def, only a DLL and textures (read from its files 2026-10-18, not seen in game), so it adds no name to the table. Read as a runtime swap, it makes Fat, Hulk and Thin look different on a male and a female pawn: photograph each of these three on both sexes (Nelim for the female, her male alter ego Soren, a second colonist, for the male; scenarios body-gallery-1 to 3 of pickletools-body-gallery.feature), plus Male and Female once each and Baby and Child. About 12 photographs. Add the mod to the map of any body photograph pass.

Seren

Xenotype Seren : planche 1701

1701 Seren personnages - pawn - 1

Seren : Which face set is loaded

LoadFolders.xml picks one face-part set by active mods. Defs of a set that is not loaded do not exist: asking the step for one of them fails.

Set (folder under 1.6/Compatibility/)Loaded when
Facial Animations - ExperimentalsNals.FacialAnimation and Nals.FacialAnimationExperimentals active. This is the set of the NSB map wsl-deps.sanctuary-seren.map.
Facial Animations - Vanilla Textures ExpandedNals.FacialAnimation and VanillaExpanded.VTEXE.FacialAnims active, Experimentals not active
Facial Animations - NiceFAAndromeda.FacialAnimation (or .ALT) active

All face parts target the gene OL_SerenEyes (skin parts target a marking gene): a pawn without OL_SerenEyes does not get them.

Seren : Experimentals set (the one NSB loads)

PartdefNamesNotes
Head (3)SerenHeadNormal, SerenHeadPointy, SerenHeadSquaretexPath Things/Pawn/Seren/Heads_Blank/<Name>
Lids (7)SerenLidNormal, SerenLidGeek, SerenLidPointy, SerenLidFlashy, SerenLidQuite, SerenLidSleepy, SerenLidSharpSerenLidGeek is gender Female only. Quite is the spelling in the def
Eyeballs (4)SerenEyesNormal, SerenEyesDull, SerenEyesIntense, SerenEyesEmptyprobability 1 (Normal), 0.25, 0.25, 0.1
Brows (2)SerenBrowNormal, SerenBrowThick
Mouth (2)SerenMouthNormal, SerenMouthHappySerenMouthHappy has probability 0: never random, set it by name only
Emotion (1)SerenEmotionNormalan EmotionTypeDef, not a face part of the Nelim step
Skin (7)SerenBrows, SerenCenterLarge, SerenCenterSmall, SerenCheeks, SerenFreckles, SerenTarget, SerenTriStareach targets one marking gene: SerenMarkings_Brows, _Big, _Small, _Cheeks, _Freckles, _Target, _Tristar

The patch of this set removes the renderNodeProperties of OL_SerenEyes and of the 7 marking genes (the face parts draw them instead) and swaps the ear texture to Things/Seren/Ears/FacialAnimations/SerenEars.

Seren : Names NSB failed on: `SerenLidCheerful` and `SerenLidSimple`

They do not exist in any set. Nearest names:

AskedSetReal defNameTexture
SerenLidCheerfulVanilla Textures Expanded onlyOL_SerenLidCheerfulFAThings/Pawn/Seren/Lids/Cheerful
SerenLidSimpleVanilla Textures Expanded onlyOL_SerenLidSimpleFAThings/Pawn/Seren/Lids/Simple

These two are not loaded with Experimentals. To have a cheerful or simple Seren lid on the NSB map, either load the VTE facial animation set (VanillaExpanded.VTEXE.FacialAnims, and then Experimentals must be off: the folders are exclusive), or pick an Experimentals lid: for a cheerful look SerenLidFlashy or SerenLidNormal, for a plain one SerenLidNormal. Only a photograph of each tells which fits; none is made yet.

Seren : Vanilla Textures Expanded set (not loaded by NSB)

The VTE set builds its parts inside one patch (it needs the mod Vanilla Textures Expanded - [NL] Facial Animation), and keeps the vanilla head types.

PartdefNames
Eyeballs (4)OL_SerenEyeNormalFA, OL_SerenEyeWideFA, OL_SerenEyePointyFA, OL_SerenEyeDullFA (Female only)
Lids (11)OL_SerenLidNormalFA, OL_SerenLidAlmondFA, OL_SerenLidCheerfulFA, OL_SerenLidUnimpressedFA (texture Sleepy), OL_SerenLidFlirtyFA (texture Flashy), OL_SerenLidStuffedFA, OL_SerenLidHardenedFA, OL_SerenLidSimpleFA, OL_SerenLidSquintingFA, OL_SerenBionicLeftFA, OL_SerenBionicRightFA (the two bionic ones have probability 0)
Brows (1)OL_SerenBrowNone
Skin (7)same names as Experimentals (SerenBrows ... SerenTriStar)
ColourOL_SerenEyes_FAColor

Its second patch (Remove_Biotech_Markings_When_FA) removes the render nodes of the eyes and the markings, as Experimentals does.

Seren : Xenotype

One: OL_SerenBase (label "seren"). Genes: OL_SerenPhysiology, OL_SerenBlood, OL_SerenEyes, OL_SerenEars, OL_DarkVision, OL_ElongatedFingers, Hair_Grayless, Beard_NoBeardOnly (Ideology), Body_Thin, Body_Standard, Libido_Low, and the pools above (13 skin, 19 hair, 8 sensors, 7 markings, 6 body masks). Name makers: NamerSerenMale, NamerSerenFemale (name banks SerenFirstMale, SerenFirstFemale, SerenLast, SerenDeity in Common/Languages/English/Strings/NameBanks/).

Face animations

face-animations.md

Scan of 2026-11-03: scripts/Search-Workshop.sh -p FaceAnimationDef -i *.xml over the Workshop and the local Mods folder (9706 folders read), XML comments stripped, defs of the 1.6 or unversioned folders only. 668 distinct names in 18 mods. A def found is not a def loaded: a mod that is not in the mod list adds nothing, and some names are made for another race (Ratkin, Raven). The names a given mod list really loads come from the step Nelim's Pickle Tools: the facial animations are listed. Played names, with a photograph of each, are in ColonistRace/docs/FACIAL-ANIMATIONS.md (55 of the two [NL] mods); the other names are not photographed.

Play one: "Nelim" facial expression is "normal+<name>".

Cosmetic genes (scan)

cosmetic-genes.md

Scan of 2026-11-04: scripts/Search-Workshop.sh -p "<GeneDef[ >]" -i *.xml over the Workshop and the local Mods folder (9824 folders read) for the mods, XML comments stripped, 1.6 or unversioned folders only, ParentName resolved inside each mod. 3537 distinct gene names in 301 sources (vanilla + mods). A gene is listed as cosmetic when it (or its parent) sets a skin colour, a hair colour, a hair or beard tag filter, a head type, a body type, a renderNodeProperties (something drawn: ears, tails, horns, marks, wings), or a display category that contains "Cosmetic". The vanilla genes come from the game folder, not from the scan (Data/Core and Data/Biotech, GeneDefs): the 1.6 install and the 1.7.4976 install hold the same 72 cosmetic genes. A gene found is not a gene loaded: the mod must be in the mod list, and some genes also carry stats (a drawn gene may be a body part with an effect). This is names from the XML, not photographs: the photographed ones are in Genes d'apparence, Looks and Colours. A gene name may be found in two kinds (a horn that also sets a skin colour).

Genes by slot and category

genes-by-slot.md

Scan of 2026-11-04, same data as the cosmetic genes page (Search-Workshop.sh -p "<GeneDef[ >]" -i *.xml, 9824 folders, XML comments stripped, 1.6 or unversioned folders, ParentName resolved inside each mod; the vanilla genes are read from the game folder, 1.6 and 1.7 identical). All genes are here, cosmetic or not. Two ways in: the exclusion tag (exclusionTags, the slot: two genes with the same tag cannot be on one pawn, for example Fur, Headbone, BloodColor) and the display category (displayCategory, the tab of the gene editor). For each one, the genes by mod. A gene found is not a gene loaded; names from the XML, not photographs. A gene with several tags appears under each.

Exclusion tags (slots)

Tags carried by two genes or more, biggest first, then the tags with a single gene. 1007 tags.

Read on 2026-10-18 with scripts/Search-Workshop.sh (default mode, ripgrep, -i '*.xml'), pattern <(TattooDef|HairDef|BeardDef|HeadTypeDef)[ >]: 9547 of 9548 folders of the Workshop and the local Mods folder held an XML file and were read (the other one holds none). Hits Abstract="True" and commented lines are left out. 457 mods declare at least one.

Counts are text hits, not loaded defs. A mod that keeps a def in several version folders (1.4, 1.5, 1.6) counts it once per folder, and a def that LoadFolders never activates counts too (SEARCHING.md: "A defName found is not a def loaded"). Read the mod before choosing it; the catalogue run (pickletools-look-catalogue) gives the real defNames of the mods that are staged. Clothing and weapons are not in this list (their pattern is too broad: a second search).

mods-gear.md

Read on 2026-10-18 with scripts/Search-Workshop.sh (default mode, ripgrep, -i '*.xml'), pattern <(apparel|weaponTags)>: 9547 of 9548 folders read (the other one holds no XML). An <apparel> block marks a garment def, a <weaponTags> list marks a weapon def. Commented lines are left out. Only mods with at least 3 hits are listed.

Counts are text hits, not loaded defs: a def kept in several version folders counts once per folder, and one that LoadFolders never activates counts too (SEARCHING.md). Animal apparel mods are among the garments (their defs have an <apparel> block too). The catalogue run gives the real defNames of the mods that are staged.

Mods: world

mods-world.md

Read on 2026-10-18 with scripts/Search-Workshop.sh (default mode, ripgrep, -i '*.xml'), pattern <(wildness|plant|designationCategory)>: 9547 of 9548 folders read (the other one holds no XML). A <designationCategory> line marks a building the player can place from an Architect tab (its value is the tab: Furniture, Structure, Production, Misc, ...; furniture and props are told apart by it), a <wildness> line an animal, an empty <plant> block a plant. Commented lines are left out. Only mods with at least 3 hits per list are shown.

Counts are text hits, not loaded defs: a def kept in several version folders counts once per folder, and one that LoadFolders never activates counts too (SEARCHING.md). A building that is only reachable through a research or a mod setting counts as well. The exact buildings of the mods that are staged, with size and research, come from the catalogue run (pickletools-building-catalogue, CATALOGUE-BUILDINGS.md).

Gaps

gaps.md

Method: the 235 steps of docs/steps.md (353 steps of Nelim's Pickle Tools) that take a {string}, grouped by what the string names, against the catalogues in ColonistRace/docs/ and docs/SANCTUAIRE-LIEUX.md. Pickle's own 238 steps were not read (their catalogue is Docs/steps.md of RimWorks/Rimworld-Pickle).

Rule (owner, 2026-10-25): a catalogue is only for what is visual (one photograph per value). Lists that nobody looks at (thoughts, sounds, research, ideologies, scenarios, storytellers, difficulties, traders, stats, jobs, interface keys) get no catalogue: the step fails and lists the valid names when a value is wrong, which is enough.

Have

Hairstyles, beards, head types, face and body tattoos (Roo's two mods added 2026-10-25), body types, garments, hats, colours, eye and skin colour genes, face parts and expressions, weapons and crafts, utility items, buildings, animals and plants by mod, the Sanctuary places.

What to build next

The listing steps are cheap (one line per mod, like LookCatalogueSteps): xenotypes, genes, pawn kinds and the studio presets are the four to write after the weather. Owner to choose the order; only the weather listing is built.

Seren body masks

catalogue.md

Seren Biotech Extended adds the 12 body masks of the original Seren mod (2704627783) to the Biotech fork of Seren (3726565301). Each mask is a gene: SerenOriginalMask_0 to SerenOriginalMask_11. A pawn wears one mask at most (same exclusion tag as the fork masks, SerenBodyMask). The masks are drawn on the body in the pale second colour of the pawn, or in white (235, 238, 255) when the pawn has no accent gene.

The Seren sheets of the NPT catalogue (seren.md and the sheets 07xx to 1xxx) stay on their own pages: this page only describes how the masks are sized and baked.

The 12 masks

  • Mask 0: a crescent on the chest.
  • Mask 1: a sun, drawn in white as in the original.
  • Mask 5: a diffuse galaxy with one bright star, stays inside the body silhouette.
  • Mask 6: fluffy pants in three tones, from the waist to the feet, wavy top edge.
  • Masks 2, 3, 4, 7 to 11: other patterns of the original, same rules as below.

How a mask is drawn

RuleWhat it does
CanvasThe art is a square picture for the body of the original Seren, north, east and south facings.
Mask 6 bakeAt startup, the art is stretched over each Naked body picture from the feet to the waist, each row fitted to the skin width, then clipped to the skin.
Other masks, adult bodiesAt startup, the art is clipped to the skin of each adult Naked body picture, so nothing is drawn past the silhouette of a body narrower than the original.
Child and baby bodiesThe mask is mapped from the adult body onto the child body: same relative place, scale from the ratio of the two body pictures.
Draw scaleThe mask is drawn at the scale of the body node. The game attachment worker multiplies by the average of the body graphic scale (0.8 on Thin, 0.5 on Baby), which left the masks too small before the fix of 2026-11-02.
ShaderTransparent, so the tones of the pants and the haze of the galaxy keep their alpha levels.

Where the pants start on the Realistic Bodies

Share of the skin height from the feet: the navel mark plus about a tenth of the height, so the top of the pants sits just above the navel.

Size check

The check photographs the masks on an undressed purple-skinned pawn, front and back, and on a blue-skinned one. The masks must reach the sides and the bottom outline of the body. The photographs above come from the run of 2026-11-02 on the Thin Female body.

Rhy'aeth parts

PickleTools/ColonistRace/docs/catalogues/rhyaeth.md, mod Erin's Rhy'aeth (3707527452)

Generated by Docs/Generate-RhyaethCatalogue.js on 2026-11-02 from the Defs of Erin's Rhy'aeth (Workshop 3707527452, packageId Erin.Rhyaeth, needs Biotech and Vanilla Expanded Framework): 31 defs. Texture paths are under Things/Pawn/ERN_Rhyaeth/. A gene is applied with the step "<pawn>" has the gene "<defName>"; a head type is the one a head gene forces.

Contact sheets

2901 Parties du corps Rhyaeth - Rhyaeth - 1
2902 Parties du corps Rhyaeth - Rhyaeth - 2

One photograph per body part gene on Nelim in panties, every other gene removed first: south and north for the parts, south for the scale colours, south and east for the head type. The head is not drawn: Nelim carries the gene and the head type ERN_RhyaethFemale (set by name), and the silhouette stays a normal head, probably because Facial Animation draws its own head. The male head type is not photographed (it needs a male colonist).
